meta.title: Participation Status Tracking: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Participation Status Tracking is refused or unavailable.
Repeat the same action as a Buyer and verify that stage-wise per-vendor participation status tracking is available.
Compare the tenant's RBAC configuration to determine whether access is intentionally granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Participation Status Tracking is refused or unavailable.; Repeat the same action as a Buyer and verify that stage-wise per-vendor participation status tracking is available.; Compare the tenant's RBAC configuration to determine whether access is intentionally granted to additional roles.

steps.note: Open an existing event so the tester can attempt the role-dependent participation-status action in the relevant event context.

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer user, attempt stage-wise per-vendor Participation Status Tracking, then repeat the same action as a Buyer in the same tenant and report whether each role is refused, absent, or allowed

steps.note: The catalog has no step for switching to another user's role or observing this dedicated tracking feature.
Verify the event screen remains usable after the tester's role-comparison attempt.
